arxiv-2202-10816.title: Why Fair Labels Can Yield Unfair Predictions: Graphical Conditions for Introduced Unfairness
arxiv-2202-10816.creator: Carolyn Ashurst, Ryan Carey, Silvia Chiappa, Tom Everitt
arxiv-2202-10816.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carolyn Ashurst, Ryan Carey, Silvia Chiappa, Tom Everitt. In addition to reproducing discriminatory relationships in the training data, machine learning systems can also introduce or amplify discriminatory effects. We refer to this as introduced unfairness , and investigate the conditions under which it may arise. To this end, we propose introduced total variation as a measure of introduced unfairness, and establish graphical conditions under which it may be incentivised to occur.

arxiv-2204-05922.title: Controlling topological phases of matter with quantum light
arxiv-2204-05922.creator: Olesia Dmytruk, Marco Schirò
arxiv-2204-05922.description: Abstract Controlling the topological properties of quantum matter is a major goal of condensed matter physics. A major effort in this direction has been devoted to using classical light in the form of Floquet drives to manipulate and induce states with non-trivial topology. A different route can be achieved with cavity photons.

arxiv-2206-09267.title: Quantum Cosmology in Thick Brane
arxiv-2206-09267.creator: S. H. Hendi 1,2,4 N. Riazi 3 and S. N. Sajadi 1,2
arxiv-2206-09267.description: Abstract One of the interesting open problems in the cosmological framework is applying quantum physics to the whole universe, consistently. Although different conceptual aspects of quantum cosmology are still very much alive, till now, all the attempts of obtaining a unique and well-defined version of quantum cosmology have been unfeasible.

arxiv-2305-08594.title: Improving Customer Experience in Call Centers with Intelligent Customer-Agent Pairing
arxiv-2305-08594.creator: Stylianos Filippou, Andreas Tsiartas, Petros Hadjineophytou, Spyros Christofides, Kleanthis Malialis, Christos G. Panayiotou
arxiv-2305-08594.description: Abstract Customer experience plays a critical role for a profitable organisation or company. A satisfied customer for a company corresponds to higher rates of customer retention, and better representation in the market. One way to improve customer experience is to optimize the functionality of its call center.

arxiv-2403-00937.title: Iterative Methods for Navier–Stokes Inverse Problems
arxiv-2403-00937.creator: Liam O’Connor 1,2 , Daniel Lecoanet 1,2 , Evan H. Anders 3 , Kyle C. Augustson 1,2 , Keaton J. Burns 4 , Geoffrey M. Vasil 5 , Jeffrey S. Oishi 6 , Benjamin P. Brown 7
arxiv-2403-00937.description: Abstract Even when the partial differential equation underlying a physical process can be evolved forward in time, the retrospective (backward in time) inverse problem often has its own challenges and applications. Direct Adjoint Looping (DAL) is the defacto approach for solving retrospective inverse problems, but it has not been applied to deterministic retrospective Navier–Stokes inverse problems in 2D or 3D.

arxiv-2406-14483.title: Valid Error Bars for Neural Weather Models using Conformal Prediction
arxiv-2406-14483.creator: Vignesh Gopakumar, Joel Oskarrson, Ander Gray, Lorenzo Zanisi, Stanislas Pamela, Daniel Giles, Matt Kusner, Marc Deisenroth
arxiv-2406-14483.description: Abstract Neural weather models have shown immense potential as inexpensive and accurate alternatives to physics-based models. However, most models trained to perform weather forecasting do not quantify the uncertainty associated with their forecasts. This limits the trust in the model and the usefulness of the forecasts.

arxiv-2406-17626.title: CoSafe: Evaluating Large Language Model Safety in Multi-Turn Dialogue Coreference
arxiv-2406-17626.creator: Erxin Yu, Jing Li, Ming Liao, Siqi Wang, Zuchen Gao, Fei Mi, Lanqing Hong
arxiv-2406-17626.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) constantly evolve, ensuring their safety remains a critical research problem. Previous red teaming approaches for LLM safety have primarily focused on single prompt attack or goal hijacking. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to study LLM safety in multi-turn dialogue coreference.

arxiv-2512-03997.title: Comment on "Monochromatization interaction region optics design for direct s-channel Higgs production at FCC-ee" Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research A
arxiv-2512-03997.creator: D. Shatilov
arxiv-2512-03997.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by D. Shatilov. The original article [ 1 ] can be logically divided into two parts: 1) the selection of main parameters for monochromatization and 2) interaction region optics design; the comment pertains only to the first part. The authors of [ 1 ] state that "The purpose of this paper is to report on the development of realistic IR optics designs for monochromatization at the FCC-ee". However, the proposed parameters do not seem very realistic and raise many questions.

pmc-10646884.title: Evolving treatment paradigms in metastatic or recurrent low-grade endometrial cancer: When is hormonal-based therapy the preferred option?
pmc-10646884.creator: Haider Mahdi, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, Domenica Lorusso, Mansoor Raza Mirza, Bradley J Monk, Brian Slomovitz
pmc-10646884.description: Endometrial cancer is the most common gynecologic malignancy in developed countries, with increasing incidence and mortality rates worldwide. While most cases are successfully treated with surgery, first-line treatment options for metastatic or recurrent endometrial cancer involve significant toxicities. Imprecise classification of heterogeneous subgroups further complicates treatment decisions and interpretation of clinical trial results.

pmc-11325694.title: Arthroscopic reduction and hollow screw internal fixation for Eyres Type IIIA scapular coracoid fracture: a case report
pmc-11325694.creator: Weizhao Xie, Dahai Hu, Huige Hou, Xiaofei Zheng
pmc-11325694.description: BackgroundA coracoid process fracture combined with an acromioclavicular (AC) joint dislocation is an uncommon injury that typically causes significant pain and limits shoulder movement. Open reduction and internal fixation have been the traditional treatment approach. However, arthroscopic techniques are emerging as a promising alternative for managing these injuries.Case representationA 35-year-old woman presented with right shoulder pain following an accidental fall.

pmc-11426948.title: Aetiologies of Ear Infections Among Patients Who Visited King Fahad Hospital in Al-Baha, Saudi Arabia
pmc-11426948.creator: Hasan Alfahemi, Mohammed Alghamdi, Mujtaba A Fadlalla, Muhammad Halwani, Rabei M Elbadry, Mujahid K Alghamdi, Fahad S Alghamdi, Abdullah M Alghamdi, Talal A Sallam
pmc-11426948.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundEar infections encompass otitis media (OM) which is a significant cause of hearing loss and otitis externa (OE) which may affect the surrounding tissues leading to serious complications. This study reports the common pathogens causing ear infections.MethodsMicrobiological, clinical, and demographic data of ear-infected patients who visited King Fahad Hospital in Al-Baha, Saudi Arabia, during the period from January 2019 to June 2023 were enrolled in this study.Result This study enrolled 307 patients aged 1-94 years, with a median age of 40 years

pmc-11435180.title: Effect of Delayed Irrigation at the Jointing Stage on Nitrogen, Silicon Nutrition and Grain Yield of Winter Wheat in the North China Plain
pmc-11435180.creator: Hao Zheng, Jinyang Sun, Yueping Liang, Caiyun Cao, Yang Gao, Junpeng Zhang, Hongkai Dang, Chunlian Zheng
pmc-11435180.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Water scarcity is a key limitation to winter wheat production in the North China Plain, and it is essential to explore the optimal timing of spring irrigation to optimize N and Si uptake as well as to safeguard yields. The aim of this study was to systematically study the effect mechanism of nitrogen and silicon absorption of winter wheat on yield under spring irrigation and to provide a scientific basis for optimizing irrigation strategy during the growth period of winter wheat.

pmc-11476439.title: Characterization and Expression of the Cytochrome P450 Genes in Daphnia magna Exposed to Cerium Oxide Nanoparticles
pmc-11476439.creator: Xinyi Kang, Yan Zhou, Qi Liu, Miao Liu, Jing Chen, Yuanwen Zhang, Jie Wei, Yuan Wang, Patrick M Dansette
pmc-11476439.description: As cerium oxide nanoparticles (nCeO2) continue to infiltrate aquatic environments, the resulting health risks to exposed aquatic organisms are becoming evident. Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes are integral to the detoxification processes in these species. Herein, we conducted a genomic analysis of CYPs in Daphnia magna, encompassing phylogenetic relationships, gene structure, and chromosomal localization. We identified twenty-six CYPs in D.

pmc-11501034.title: Diagnostic serology test comparison for Q fever and Rift Valley fever in humans and livestock from pastoral communities
pmc-11501034.creator: Valerie Hungerbühler, Ranya Özcelik, Mahamat Fayiz Abakar, Fatima Abdelrazak Zakaria, Martin Eiden, Sonja Hartnack, Pidou Kimala, Sonja Kittl, Janine Michel, Franziska Suter-Riniker, Salome Dürr, Elvina Viennet, Philip Mshelbwala, Elvina Viennet, Philip Mshelbwala, Elvina Viennet, Philip Mshelbwala
pmc-11501034.description: Q fever (QF) and Rift Valley fever (RVF) are endemic zoonotic diseases in African countries, causing significant health and economic burdens. Accurate prevalence estimates, crucial for disease control, rely on robust diagnostic tests. While enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) are not the gold standard, they offer rapid, cost-effective, and practical alternatives.

pmc-11691012.title: RACIAL DIFFERENCES IN PREDICTORS OF CARDIOMETABOLIC RISK FOR OLDER US WOMEN
pmc-11691012.creator: Christy Erving, K J Davidson-Turner, Cleothia Frazier, Jacquelyn Coats
pmc-11691012.description: Though cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death among women, significant racial disparities in cardiovascular disease persist. This study investigated psychosocial predictors of cardiometabolic risk (CMR), a count of high-risk cardiovascular and metabolic biomarkers, among older U.S women and whether predictors differed for Black, and Hispanic, and White respondents.

pmc-12768746.title: OP30 Integrating Real-World Evidence Into Health Technology Assessment In The Americas Region: A Collaborative Initiative By RedETSA
pmc-12768746.creator: Sebastian Garcia Marti, Guadalupe Montero, Graciela Fernandez, Carlos Rezende, Maricela Curisinche, Mariana Beatriz Pineda-López
pmc-12768746.description: IntroductionThe Health Technology Assessment Network of the Americas (RedETSA) working groups gather members aiming to develop projects and research jointly. The Real-World Evidence (RWE) Working Group seeks to identify methodologies and approaches allowing RWE integration into health technology assessment (HTA) in the region. This collaborative initiative is crucial to enhancing evidence-based decision-making processes in the Americas, shaping regional health policies.

pmc-13062263.title: Navigating the Challenges of Stenotrophomonas maltophilia Infections in Chronic Kidney Disease: A Case Report
pmc-13062263.creator: Joydip Chowdhury, Prince Shah‐Riar, Druba Sheesh Debnath, Shahida Afnan, Muniza Mobin Maha
pmc-13062263.description: S. maltophilia is a multidrug‐resistant nosocomial pathogen that poses significant challenges in CKD patients. Antibiotic selection in CKD is complicated by nephrotoxicity concerns and limited clinical data. Combination therapy and novel agents like cefiderocol and CZA‐ATM are emerging alternatives but require further validation.

pmc-13389522.title: Dual-interface stabilization of low-iridium anodes for durable proton exchange membrane water electrolysis
pmc-13389522.creator: Eui Tae Kim, Sangwoo Kim, Sung-Eun Park, Pumsuk Park, Eunbyeol Ko, Jemee Joe, Ho Yeon Son, Juyeon Kang, Julie Junesoo Kim, Kibeom Cheon, Kyungin Kim, Soree Kim, Geunsung Lee, Jaehak Jeong, Manki Cho, Noma Kim, Jai Hyun Koh, Kihwan Kim
pmc-13389522.description: The durability and cost of iridium-based anodes remain key challenges for high-current density operation of proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers. Here, we report a dual-interface stabilization strategy based on atomic layer deposition of TiO2 onto IrO2 catalysts. The resulting anodes sustain operation at 3.0 A cm−2 for 2600 h with near-zero voltage degradation at an iridium loading of 0.

pmc-13524943.title: Workflow evaluation of a commercial deep learning-based image analysis tool for the quantification of angiogenesis in vivo
pmc-13524943.creator: Christoph Raphael Buhr, Alexander Philippe Maas, Nadine Wiesmann-Imilowski, Juergen Brieger, Christoph Matthias, Benjamin Philipp Ernst, Anita Kloss-Brandstaetter, Philipp Herrmann, Jonas Eckrich
pmc-13524943.description: Angiogenesis plays a crucial role in tumor development as well as in wound healing and integration of biomaterials. However, quantification of complex vascular networks across different in vivo models is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to human error. Deep learning-based analysis (DLBA) appears to be a more efficient and reproducible method for vascular quantification .

pmc-13608166.title: Immediate Effects of a Pogo-Jump Microdose on Vertical Jump Performance in Adolescent Basketball Players: A Randomized Crossover Pilot Study
pmc-13608166.creator: Celia García-Lucas, Gemma Biviá-Roig, Ramón Pascual-Morales, Jorge Escribá-Fuentes, Iván Muñoz-Martínez, Sergio Samper-Llavador, Francesc Josep Llidó-Barreres, Pedro Múzquiz-Barberá, Juan Francisco Lisón, Juan José Amer-Cuenca
pmc-13608166.description: Background and Objectives: Low-volume plyometric conditioning may elicit post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE), but the early response to pogo-jump exercise in adolescent basketball players remains uncertain. This randomized crossover pilot study estimated the effect of adding 24 bilateral pogo jumps to a standardized warm-up on countermovement-jump (CMJ) and drop-jump (DJ) height, compared with time-matched low-intensity walking.
